Color & material mood board

A visual system derived from the product film’s own palette and imagery.

Night charcoal#101114Primary background and campaign collage
Soft black#070809Brand close and negative space
Warm ivory#F3F0E9Clean logo and social end card
Campaign amber#C98B54Warm product/editorial highlights
Creator coral#D76D63People-led campaign accents
Reflective silver#A8AFB5Bathroom products and mirror moments

Editorial charcoal

A deep neutral frame lets social cards and bathroom photography carry the color.

Creator portrait panels

Preserve the vertical creator assets in full, using equal panel rhythm and enough hold time to recognize faces.

Warm campaign imagery

Let warm interiors, skin tones, wood and amber light add contrast to the charcoal social wall.

White social end card

Finish cleanly with the account/hashtag treatment; displayed follower/post counts are time-sensitive.

Art direction

Practical guidance for recreating the visual language.

Composition

Treat the feed as layered editorial cards. Never crop the vertical social posts; keep the full original frame inside its panel.

Lighting & grade

Carry warm room tones and natural skin tones. Avoid over-darkening creator footage to match the background.

Motion

Use card slides, parallax, selective push-ins and crisp transitions. Slow down on campaign titles and faces.

Graphics

Retain source campaign tags, captions and creator IDs from the master. Verify all small copy before re-use.

Shot-by-shot storyboard

The reference image on every shot card contains the full 16:9 frame; images are not cropped.

Shot 0100:00 – 00:05

A quiet brand opening

The film opens on a bright, minimal KOHLER India identity before moving into a larger world of design content.

On-screen text / UI

KOHLER India brand lock-up; small tagline beneath (read from master if needed).

Camera & edit

Keep the opening logo centered and crisp; fade into the social content rather than using a hard cut.

Script / sound

Brand-level musical cue; no additional narration required on the logo.

Shot 0200:05 – 00:11

Enter the social world

A collage of social posts, bathroom photography and vertical creator content expands across a charcoal backdrop.

On-screen text / UI

Social post panels and product/interior images; campaign tags begin to appear.

Camera & edit

Animate cards into place with layered depth and restrained parallax. Preserve the full vertical posts inside their frames.

Script / sound

Build rhythm with the edits; keep the music energetic but premium.

Shot 0300:11 – 00:18

Bold-look inspiration

A montage of designed bathrooms and product posts gives the audience a fast visual survey of KOHLER's style world.

On-screen text / UI

“#Bold Look bathroom designs” is visible in a lower caption; other post UI comes from the master.

Camera & edit

Mix quick push-ins with brief holds on each post. Use consistent margins to keep the montage from feeling cluttered.

Script / sound

Rhythmic editorial beat; let each featured image register before the next arrives.

Shot 0400:18 – 00:23

Campaign identity

A campaign poster and title treatment take over from the social grid, shifting from broad inspiration to a named content platform.

On-screen text / UI

“Inspired Everyday” / “#KohlerReflections” styling appears in the campaign title treatment; verify exact wording and punctuation.

Camera & edit

Let the title come into focus through a gentle scale or opacity move; avoid over-animating the lettering.

Script / sound

Brief musical lift to signal a chapter change.

Shot 0500:23 – 00:30

Design voices

Three portrait panels introduce designers, architects or campaign contributors, each treated like a distinct editorial card.

On-screen text / UI

Portrait names/role captions and a small “Architect engagement” label are visible in this sequence.

Camera & edit

Use equal card widths and aligned baselines; animate selection emphasis rather than moving all cards at once.

Script / sound

Retain any source dialogue if present; this storyboard does not transcribe the spoken clips.

Shot 0600:30 – 00:38

Spaces, people and products

The card system returns to room imagery, product photography and creator posts, connecting the voices to finished spaces.

On-screen text / UI

Mix of social tiles, room imagery, engagement labels and KOHLER corner mark.

Camera & edit

Cut between full-room images and mobile-style cards. Keep important product silhouettes unobstructed.

Script / sound

Use a consistent music pulse across the montage.

Shot 0700:38 – 00:46

Creator engagement

Portraits and creator-style content are displayed in a multi-panel layout, giving the film a human, participatory tone.

On-screen text / UI

Vertical portraits and “Architect engagement”/creator-style labels.

Camera & edit

Use subtle vertical-card movement. Allow each face and caption to remain readable for a moment.

Script / sound

If source speech is retained, duck music beneath it; otherwise let the soundtrack carry the pacing.

Shot 0800:46 – 00:53

Campaigns in real life

The feed shifts through interior scenes and creator visits, showing how the brand appears in lived-in spaces and campaign storytelling.

On-screen text / UI

“Influencers visits” label appears in the source montage.

Camera & edit

Sequence the posts with a clear visual hierarchy: hero content first, social metadata second.

Script / sound

Slightly quicker transitions to carry momentum into the next campaign segment.

Shot 0900:53 – 00:59

Pure Clean campaign

A creator-led vertical clip features a presenter asking or answering a question, followed by campaign imagery.

On-screen text / UI

“Pure Clean Campaign” and a visible “Why?” prompt in the creator frame.

Camera & edit

Hold on the question moment, then cut to supporting bathroom/cleaning visuals; keep subtitles away from the phone frame edges.

Script / sound

Retain the creator's original vocal track if available; music should support rather than compete.

Shot 1000:59 – 01:05

Mirror campaign

Content moves into mirror-focused creator/product scenes, introducing a different product category within the campaign universe.

On-screen text / UI

Mirror-campaign label and vertical creator content.

Camera & edit

Use clean match cuts between reflective surfaces and on-phone content. Control highlights on mirrors.

Script / sound

Add a bright but restrained transition cue; avoid excessive sparkle effects.

Shot 1101:05 – 01:12

Celebrity and creator endorsements

A mix of product imagery and people-led clips signals the breadth of brand collaborations.

On-screen text / UI

“Celebrity Endorsements” label is visible in this segment.

Camera & edit

Keep the sequence moving, but give hero products a longer hold than secondary feed elements.

Script / sound

Music reaches a confident high point; source dialogue remains primary when present.

Shot 1201:12 – 01:19

Multiple campaign touchpoints

Vertical reels, bathroom images and campaign posts alternate to show the brand across several formats.

On-screen text / UI

Campaign labels and post overlays from the original montage.

Camera & edit

Use repeated card geometry to tie different campaign assets together. Keep the background dark and unobtrusive.

Shot 1301:19 – 01:24

Brand punctuation

A dark brand frame briefly isolates the KOHLER identity after the rapid social montage.

On-screen text / UI

KOHLER logo / end-frame branding.

Camera & edit

Give the mark a short, steady hold; let the dark background create contrast.

Script / sound

Music resolves or drops to a clean downbeat.

Shot 1401:24 – 01:30

A campaign victory beat

A distinctive celebratory campaign graphic follows, with a tall central creative against a dark, atmospheric background.

On-screen text / UI

A red “IT'S A GOAL” graphic and congratulations copy appear; verify all small text against the original before repurposing.

Camera & edit

Keep the central vertical artwork square to frame, preserving its full aspect ratio.

Script / sound

Use a short accent to land the reveal; do not add a literal crowd sound unless present in the master.

Shot 1501:30 – 01:36

Social profile and follow-through

The film transitions to a bright social-profile presentation showing the account and content grid.

On-screen text / UI

Instagram-style profile for @kohler_India; follower and post counts are part of the source screen and may be time-sensitive.

Camera & edit

Hold long enough for brand/account recognition. Avoid treating displayed engagement counts as evergreen claims.

Script / sound

A gentle musical release begins the close.

Shot 1601:36 – 01:42.3

Hashtag close

A minimal light field and repeated hashtag finish the sequence with a simple social callout.

On-screen text / UI

“#kohler_India” appears in the final frames.

Camera & edit

Center the hashtag, use a slow fade and leave generous negative space.

Script / sound

Allow the final tone to decay naturally.

Production note
Brand open → social feed and design inspiration → named campaigns → architect/designer voices → influencer/creator visits → campaign-specific clips → brand punctuation → social follow-through.

Creator-led footage is visible in the master. Keep any original spoken lines from the approved edit; the shot notes do not claim to transcribe dialogue.
